access.zh: API（Gemini API / Vertex）与 Gemini 应用订阅；权重不开源（开放权重的是另一条 Gemma 线）。
access.en: API (Gemini API / Vertex) and the Gemini app subscription; weights are not open (the open-weight line is Gemma).

generations.zh: 当前代：官方开发者指南列 gemini-3.1-pro / 3-flash / 3.1-flash-lite 等，全部 1M 输入 / 64K 输出上下文，知识截点 2025-01；指南页注明「所有 Gemini 3 模型目前均为预览版」。
generations.en: Current line: the official developer guide lists gemini-3.1-pro / 3-flash / 3.1-flash-lite etc., all 1M input / 64K output context, knowledge cutoff Jan 2025; the guide notes all Gemini 3 models are still in preview.

generations.en: Previous line (2.5 Pro/Flash etc.), still listed in official docs.

v.zh: 1M 输入 / 64K 输出（Gemini 3 系官方指南表）

v.zh: 官方指南注明「所有 Gemini 3 模型目前均为预览版」（2026-10-20 快照）

v.zh: 文本 / 图像 / 视频 / 音频多模态（官方指南与云博客同口径）
v.en: Multimodal text / image / video / audio (official guide and cloud blog agree)

positioning.zh: Google 的闭源旗舰线；与开放权重的 Gemma 是两条线，别混。选型注意官方「预览版」标注——预览意味着规格与价格都可能变，本站只抄快照。
positioning.en: Google's closed flagship line; distinct from the open-weight Gemma line — do not conflate them. Note the official "preview" labels: preview means specs and prices may change; this site only snapshots.

onSite.zh: 开放权重侧本站收录 Gemma 4（谱系卡 + 量化对比）；Gemini 系不开权重。
onSite.en: On the open-weight side this site covers Gemma 4 (family card + quantisation); the Gemini line ships no weights.
